fulltext_coverage: 22-page ICLR final including appendix; 21-page author arXiv version cross-checked.
focal_spatial_site: inferred binary editing mask during DDIM decoding
identifiable_comparator: DiffEdit vs Encode-Decode (same encoding, no mask); separate SDEdit contrast omits encoding too
default_coefficient_evidence: Mask threshold 0.5 is the reference. On/off arms are traversed over encoding ratios; 0.25 and 0.75 test mask threshold.
section_table_figure_page: ICLR main §4.2 Figs. 5–6 p.7; App. A.4 / Fig. 16 pp.15–16.
concrete_evidence: Fig. 6 left plots class-specific FID against input LPIPS for the masked and unmasked arms. Fig. 6 right varies threshold. Fig. 16 compares the four masking × encoding combinations from 30% to 80% encoding.
scope_or_uncertainty: CSFID concerns target-class fidelity at cohort level. No equal individual-source response estimate or masked-update norm calibration reported.

focal_spatial_site: foreground/background restriction on mutual self-attention queries
identifiable_comparator: unrestricted mutual attention vs mask-guided mutual attention on the same pictured example
default_coefficient_evidence: Main implementation defaults are CFG 7.5, 50 steps, start step S=4 and layer L=10. The paper specifies one standard set for the example type; no numeric mask multiplier is supplied.
section_table_figure_page: Main Fig. 2 second row p.2; §4.2 and implementation details pp.5–6; §5.5 Fig. 9 p.9. Supp. §B, Figs. 1–3 pp.1–2.
concrete_evidence: The foreground/background query restriction has a labelled with/without visual comparison, also shown for multi-object confusion in supp. Fig. 2. The mask restricts the source region queried.
scope_or_uncertainty: Fig. 9 and supp. Fig. 1 vary onset in time and network depth of mutual attention. They do not sweep the with/without mask pair. Read the default flag as one reported configuration of the switch; CFG is a separate coefficient.

focal_spatial_site: optional inversion attention mask (AM) in object removal
identifiable_comparator: +NS vs +NS+AM and +NS+RI vs +NS+AM+RI (NS no-skip; RI reinitialization)
default_coefficient_evidence: §4.1 usually skips four of 28 steps (N=24); Table 2 uses NS (N=28) and varies RI. The core foreground-only KV reconstruction remains in the compared arms.
section_table_figure_page: Main §§3.4,4.1,4.3; Table 2 p.7, Fig. 7 p.8. Supp. §A, Figs. C–D p.2.
concrete_evidence: Table 2 toggles AM in two contexts. With NS alone IR* changes 3.17 to 2.55; with NS+RI it changes 0.22 to 0.90. Fig. D changes timesteps/RI; Fig. C diagrams a tunable attention bias.
scope_or_uncertainty: Two measured AM pairs support a multi-context ablation. Neither the core KV routing nor matching by response or realized magnitude is isolated by those rows.

focal_spatial_site: soft spatial update weights vs uniform update scaling
identifiable_comparator: [λ+(1−λ)M]ΔV vs λΔV, both at default CFG on their own trajectories
default_coefficient_evidence: Each control is evaluated at λ=0,.2,.4,.6,.8,1; λ=1 is their shared raw FlowEdit endpoint. Same λ does not impose equal response or realized update norm.
section_table_figure_page: App. D.1 pp.16–17, Eqs. 10–11 and Fig. 7; D.2–D.4 pp.17–19, Figs. 8–9/Table 5; E.4 p.21 Table 9.
concrete_evidence: Fig. 7 compares background LPIPS across spatial/uniform curves at comparable edited-region CLIP; LPIPS uses 556 local tasks. E.4 rescales a no-CFG update to the default-CFG Frobenius norm on the current states with shared noise.
scope_or_uncertainty: Table 9 tests the CFG directions; its treated pair is not the Fig. 7 spatial/uniform pair. No per-source common-support integral is reported in D.1.

focal_spatial_site: similarity threshold τ determining the high-similarity velocity replacement region
identifiable_comparator: six thresholds from 0 to 1 on each of two backbones
default_coefficient_evidence: §4.1 distinguishes τ=0.4 for consistency from τ=0.8 for continuity; N=1 is the principal intervention window.
section_table_figure_page: Method §3 and Alg. 1 pp.5–6; experimental settings p.8; §4.3 Tables 4–5 p.10; §6.4 and Figs. 17–20 pp.22–25.
concrete_evidence: Table 4 varies τ in 0.2 increments; Table 5 varies intervention length N from 1 to 6. Directional CLIP and change metrics are tabulated across settings.
scope_or_uncertainty: A threshold sweep and visual edit-strength trajectories do not equate responses of specified spatial and counterfactual arms. Velocity similarity used to form the mask does not match the magnitude of two applied updates.

focal_spatial_site: attention masking of disentangled prompt guidance (also applied on the cross-trajectory path)
identifiable_comparator: full InstantEdit vs DPG without mask in main Table 4
response_design: approximate study-level alignment for spatial ablation
default_coefficient_evidence: Full setting DPG 2.5, threshold 0.4. Supp. B explicitly adjusts DPG scale for the Table 4 ablations except the PG ablation. Fixed on/off DPG values for the mask pair are unverified.
section_table_figure_page: Main §§4.3,5.3, Fig. 8 p.7 and Table 4 p.8; supp. §§A–B/D–E p.1, Tables 1/6 p.2, Table 7 p.3.
concrete_evidence: Supp. B describes rough editability alignment for Table 4, which includes the explicit mask-off row. Full vs no mask gives edited-region CLIP 22.82 vs 22.25 and reported background LPIPS×1000 44.39 vs 65.68. Table 7 varies mask threshold 0.2/0.6/0.8.
scope_or_uncertainty: Response matching is approximate across a dataset, with different achieved scores and no source-paired response curve. Supp. B and its explicit reference to main Table 4 are essential for this label.

focal_spatial_site: edit-mask source in FlowChef-Edit on FLUX
identifiable_comparator: ConceptAttention (CA) vs human annotation (HA), with spatial control in both
default_coefficient_evidence: Two mask sources are compared. An all-region or consistently mask-disabled FlowChef editing row is not identified in this comparison.
section_table_figure_page: Main §5.2, Table 4 and Fig. 5, p.8 (15315); supp. Alg. 3 p.6, Table 7 p.7, §17 Figs. 10–13 pp.8–10.
concrete_evidence: On FLUX the CA/HA rows report background LPIPS 0.1239/0.0845 and edited CLIP 22.34/22.96. Supp. Alg. 3 defines a spatial loss and velocity operation.
scope_or_uncertainty: The CA/HA switch is categorical. Task-specific examples and optimization step/learning rate studies have different scopes; Fig. 10 uses an AFHQ-Cat inverse problem. Table 4 is not a response sweep.

focal_spatial_site: soft support, transition ring and time accumulation in source-anchored editing
identifiable_comparator: full vs hard core / ring removed / accumulation removed; anchor replacement is a separate manipulation
default_coefficient_evidence: One setting per backbone; Table A1 gives ring weights 0.50 (SD3) and 0.35 (FLUX), anchor strength ρ=1 for both. No transition ring sets R=0. No full-gate-off or common ring coefficient across the pair of backbones.
section_table_figure_page: Main §IV.C and Fig. 6 pp.8–9; App. E Table A1 p.14; App. G Eqs. A30–A52 pp.16–17, Table A5 p.17, Fig. A2 p.18.
concrete_evidence: On FLUX, full/hard mask/no ring background LPIPS are .028/.121/.085. The variant named no-source-anchored projection replaces the source anchor by the previous latent and retains the masked projection.
scope_or_uncertainty: Fig. 6 shows metric pairs for named variants; it does not sweep a common output-response coordinate. Multiple component variants and backbones are recorded separately from a spatial-setting sweep.

fulltext_coverage: 5 PDF pages; Alg. 1 and all three tables in the paper; no separate supplement identified
focal_spatial_site: instruction-attention spatial gates on the text and image CFG directions
identifiable_comparator: incumbent full ASG vs released uniform CFG; also fixed and per-image mean controls
default_coefficient_evidence: Alg. 1 uses uniform (7.5,1.5) on bypass. Table 2 identifies the incumbent full ASG at its selected default ghi=3.0 and the incumbent uniform comparator; both branches change between native operating points.
section_table_figure_page: §§2.3,3.1–3.3, Alg. 1 and Eqs. 9–11 p.3; Tables 2 and 3(a–c), Fig. 3 p.4.
concrete_evidence: Table 3(a) tests ghi=1.5,2.25,3,4.5. Table 3(c) replaces both maps with per-example spatial means; vs ASG edited CLIP changes −0.727 and background PSNR +0.06 dB.
scope_or_uncertainty: Mean gate matching is a nominal coefficient control. The paper does not equalize measured RMS of the applied CFG directions, or align the responses for the gate comparison. Selected-default comparison coexists with the other controls.

fulltext_coverage: 27-page author version; appended implementation, comparisons and figures
focal_spatial_site: progressive shrinking of a mask for thin structures
identifiable_comparator: standard static input mask vs progressively shrinking schedule
default_coefficient_evidence: One specified schedule vs schedule disabled: 7×7, 5×5, 3×3 dilations then original mask over four equal step blocks. This is an on/off test of shrinking; both conditions still blend under masks.
section_table_figure_page: §4.3 Figs. 6–7 p.6; App. C implementation pp.12–13, Fig. 16 p.15. See also Fig. 11 p.10, Fig. 20 p.20 and Fig. 25 p.24.
concrete_evidence: The standard and shrinking conditions are explicitly labelled on thin masks. The four kernel sizes belong to one run schedule. App. B.4/Fig. 20 separately removes a foreground reconstruction-loss term; λ=100 belongs to reconstruction.
scope_or_uncertainty: Perturbing an input mask in Fig. 25 is distinct from sweeping the shrinking-schedule parameter. CLIP ranking of candidates does not match two spatial controls on an output response.

section_table_figure_page: ICLR final §3.2 Alg. 1 pp.5–6, Fig. 5 p.6, §4.1 pp.7–8; App. Fig. 11 (extended injection sweep) and Fig. 21 p.26 (local blending).

focal_spatial_site: spatially indexed decoder features and self-attention maps injected across the field
identifiable_comparator: full vs w/o spatial features and w/o self-attention; depth of injection also changed
default_coefficient_evidence: App. C of author version describes feature/time thresholds τA=25, τf=40 out of 50 for standard cases and a different schedule for primitive guidance. These are injection schedules.
section_table_figure_page: Main §4 Fig. 5 p.5; Fig. 9(a) p.7 and §5.2 p.8 (1925, 1927–1928). Author appendix pp.13–14, Table 1 p.14.
